question: What effect is attributed to merely hearing this knowledge, O fair-faced one?
premises: The teaching is received as mere knowledge.
It is also received by hearing.
inference: Even mere knowledge of this teaching, simply heard, is presented as efficacious.
uncertainties: The verse states the means but leaves the specific result to be completed by the following verse.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, by this mere knowledge, simply heard,
